name: Sam-A Aluminium Company, Limited
summary: Sam-A Aluminium Company, Limited produces and manufacture and sell aluminum foil, laminated aluminum foil, and other processed products in South Korea. It offers aluminium Foil, including high gloss; decoration; hair line; and LIB cathode aluminium foils for pharmaceutical packaging, electrical capacitor, automotive, finstock, LIB pouch, and LIB tab. The company also provides foils for cigarette wrappers, refill pouch, retort packaging, cold forming foil, super water repellent leads, and cosmetic wrapping paper.
